page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s3 server family. It is provisioned with 4 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type runs on the KVM hypervisor. It does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and there are no integrated GPU accelerators.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s3.large is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not demand large memory footprints. The dedicated physical cores provide predictable execution, making it suitable for tasks such as lightweight web serving, batch processing, and basic computational workloads. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the lack of bundled local storage and specialized accelerators positions this instance as a streamlined compute resource where users only pay for the core processing and memory allocation.
